description: Nathan's chat, 2026-10-21: after a web answer about indie games, a NEW current-information question (RPGs coming out in 2026). Qwen3.5-4B answered from memory (games from 2023-24 as 2026), cited [1][4][5] that pointed at the indie answer's sources and wrote "(Yap searched the web for this answer. Its sources: ...)" itself. It must search, name this turn's games (made up: no model knows them) and cite only this turn's sources. Stand-in web.

results.title: The most anticipated RPGs of 2026
results.text: Coming in 2026: Starfall Requiem (12 March, PC and consoles), a sci-fi party RPG; Ashen Crown II (4 June), the sequel to the 2023 dark fantasy hit; Tidebound Saga (autumn 2026), an open-world pirate RPG; and Verdant Oath, a tactics RPG due in December.

results.title: 2026 RPG release calendar
results.text: Starfall Requiem: 12 March 2026. Ashen Crown II: 4 June 2026. Tidebound Saga: autumn 2026. Verdant Oath: 1 December 2026. Ember Knights Reforged: 2026, date to be announced.

results.title: The best indie games of 2026 so far
results.text: Our picks for 2026: Hollow Lantern, a hand-drawn metroidvania; Pixel Tides, a cozy fishing sim; Glasswing, a puzzle platformer about light; Burrow & Bloom, a farming game for two; and Static Hearts, a narrative mystery set in a 1990s radio station.

results.title: Indie game of the year 2026: the contenders
results.text: Hollow Lantern leads the pack with a 94 average, ahead of Glasswing (91) and Static Hearts (89). Pixel Tides is the surprise hit of the summer, and Burrow & Bloom the best co-op game of the year.

results.title: 10 cozy indie games from 2026
results.text: Pixel Tides and Burrow & Bloom top our cozy list, with Moss Letters and Teacup Harbor close behind.
